reason: noxtua.com presents a European legal AI company building AI tools for legal research, analysis and drafting (Word/Outlook add-ins, Matrix Analysis, Workflows) over 210 million searchable documents and 15.8 million court decisions, with an Athena agent on open-source models and a Minerva agent on frontier models. Its Data Engineer posting describes ETL pipelines cleaning XML-based legal data from multiple jurisdictions. This is an AI-first legal document product, so the ai variant fits, with Hsan's Mazdev legal contract review platform surfaced first.
